anchor_value: source places EUR/AUD in Par/Shares currency, not Cost currency; Cost is USD-denominated in the SOI column

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Investment (1) | Industry (2) | Interest Rate (3) | Reference Rate and Spread (3) | Maturity | Par/ Shares (4) | Cost | Fair Value | Footnotes
Hamilton Thorne, Inc. | Health Care Equipment & Supplies | 7.60 % | E + 5.50 % | 11/28/31 | EUR | 11,492 | 12,307 | 13,232 | (5) (6) (7)
Sonar Acquisitionco, Inc. (dba SimPRO) | Construction & Engineering | 8.41 % | B + 4.75 % | 10/24/30 | AUD | 5,600 | 3,684 | 3,649 | (5) (6) (7) (9)

Par amount is presented for debt investments, while the number of shares or units owned is presented for equity investments. Par amount is denominated in U.S. Dollars ("$" or "USD") unless otherwise noted, Australian Dollars ("AUD"), or Euros ("EUR").

findings.detail: EUR was read from the Par/Shares currency marker for Hamilton Thorne and propagated into cost_currency, although the EUR marker applies to par amount under footnote 4.
AUD was read from the Par/Shares currency marker for Sonar Acquisitionco and propagated into cost_currency, although the AUD marker applies to par amount under footnote 4.

rationale: Class 2 row-level currency localization. The flagged rows store cost_currency as U_EUR or U_AUD, but the raw SOI table separates Par/Shares from Cost and Fair Value. The EUR and AUD tokens appear in the Par/Shares currency position, and footnote 4 says those non-USD indicators denominate par amount. They are not cost-currency indicators. The Cost column values are separate SOI columns, so propagating the par currency into cost_currency is a real extraction/column-mapping defect.
